product.name: S11-M 2-in-1 Magnetic Split Bluetooth Speaker
product.description: A portable speaker made from two magnetically joined 10 W speaker units that can be separated for wider stereo placement.

notes: The operator reported no product video visible on the supplied listing.

script_facts: One magnetic speaker separates into two speaker units for wider placement.
A phone connects to the speaker over Bluetooth 5.3.
The separated halves can be placed on opposite sides of a room.
The advertised phone-to-speaker Bluetooth range is up to 18 meters.
The speaker supports stereo playback and has an IPX6 water-resistance rating.
